status: FROZEN — written and hashed before C1 runs
question: NOT spread reduction. Whether the two initializations share a fixed point — which every outer method depends on and nothing so far has tested.

mechanism.parameter: admm.tol.objective.rel, a CASE-FILE parameter read by _read_parameters_from_file
mechanism.method: overridden in the harness on the in-memory planning problem, exactly as P5.12-P/W/X/Y did. data/SRP1/SRP1_params.json is NOT edited.
mechanism.why_not_in_place: every preserved result would stop being reproducible from the tree, and 16-digit reproduction from the tree is now a load-bearing property (X22 reproduced a pre-C3 run exactly).
mechanism.no_code_change: the tolerance is a parameter, so no neutrality gate is required for the mechanism
mechanism.effective_tolerance: objective_tolerance = max(abs 1000, rel * recourse). At rel 1e-3 that is 827,945; at 1e-4 it is 82,795 — still ~2,500x the stabilized signal of 32.87.

configuration_inherited_from_the_2x2_ADA.rationale: so the existing 1e-3 measurements (cold_adaptive 826,829,641.1; warm_adaptive 827,735,214.6) serve as the baseline and the TOLERANCE IS THE ONLY VARIED SETTING
configuration_inherited_from_the_2x2_ADA.note: this is inherited from the 2x2, NOT from the case file. Track B governs what 'production' means; it does not gate this design.

cells.warm_1e-4: warm from frozen T0, adaptive, rel 1e-4
cells.baselines: the 2x2's cold_adaptive and warm_adaptive cells at rel 1e-3

instance: the recovered AB1 candidate, C3 active; instance and full effective configuration recorded per rule eight

cap.rule: hitting the cap is INCONCLUSIVE for that cell — no value and no offset may be read from a capped cell

predeclared_outcome_classes.proportional_shrink: the offset falls roughly in proportion to the tolerance (about 10x) -> the 0.11% was stopping slack, and Q is path-independent in the limit
predeclared_outcome_classes.plateau: the offset is materially unchanged -> Q is genuinely path-dependent, and independence at 6.6x becomes MANDATORY rather than a trade-off
predeclared_outcome_classes.indeterminate: the new offset is still smaller than its own error bar -> reported as indeterminate, and no reading of either kind is permitted

error_bar_rule: EVERY offset is reported with its error bar: the sum of the two cells' terminal per-cycle objective changes (ninth rule). A difference smaller than that error is indeterminate, not a result.

baseline_error_bar_for_reference.note: at 1e-3 the cold/warm_adaptive offset was ALREADY smaller than its own error bar (706,603.5 + 212,488.8), so the baseline comparison is itself indeterminate. C1 tests whether one decade changes that.

solve_profile.permitted_call_sites: the production ADMM and ESSO solve paths
solve_profile.identity: permitted solves == 51 * cycles + 51 (one initialization block), exactly as in all four 2x2 cells; a mismatch fails the cell
solve_profile.hard_failure: any blocked solve, or a total above the bound

C2_stop: after C1 the stage STOPS for the author's decision on a second decade. One decade costs ln(10)/(-ln r) extra cycles — about 12 at r = 0.82 but 114 at r = 0.98 — so the cost is an order of magnitude uncertain and MUST BE MEASURED, not estimated. C1 reports the realised ratio.
framing_note: varying a tolerance as the independent variable of a predeclared sweep is legitimate. It is not 'changing thresholds after seeing results', which covers classification thresholds applied post hoc. Nothing here is committed to production.
not_permitted: reading a value from a capped cell
reporting an offset without its error bar
